item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che zhi ba dbyings kyi gsang thus
item.coloph: dong ra'i bka' gter/ rma ston dngos grub la bru bdag nyid chen po'i (pos) zhus so/ zhes mnyam med rin po che'i phyag dpe dngos la zhal bshus shing / phrin las skabs go bde phyir/ bar skabs kyi yig chung phran bu rnams dang / 'bring po nas spyan dbye dang / lha rtags bcas kha bskang ste/ sgo rigs mkhan ming pa nyi ri shel bzhin gyis/ sman ri'i bla brang rim byon gyi phyag dper dmigs te bzhengs pa la zhal bshus pa dge bar gyur cig/
